text_nodes.raw_text: The elder To [the] chosen lady and children her whom I love in [the] truth and not I alone but also all who know the truth
because of the truth that abides in us and with us will be forever
will be with us Grace mercy [and] peace from God [the] Father and from Jesus Christ the Son of the Father in truth and love
I was overjoyed . . . to find [some] of children your walking in [the] truth just as has commanded [us] the Father
And now I urge you [dear] lady not as commandment to you a new but [one] we have had from [the] beginning that we love one another
And this is love that we walk according to commandments His This the commandment is very you have heard from [the] beginning that in [love] you must walk
For many deceivers have gone out into the world refusing to confess Jesus Christ the coming of in [the] flesh Any such [ person ] is the deceiver and the antichrist
Watch yourselves so that you do not lose what we have worked for but [that] . . . . . . you may be fully rewarded
Anyone who runs ahead without remaining in the teaching of Christ God does not have Whoever remains in [His] teaching both the Father and the Son has
If anyone comes to you [but] this teaching does not bring {do} not receive him into [your] home even . . . him [or] greet
Whoever greets [such a person] . . . shares in deeds his evil
many things I have to you to write not [to do so] [but] I would prefer with paper and ink Instead I hope to come with you and [face] to [face] speak so that joy our complete may be
send you greetings . . . The children sister of your elect
